titleInfo.title: Changing how the world does business
titleInfo.subTitle: FedEx's incredible journey to success : the inside story

publisher: U.S. trade bookstores and wholesalers, Publishers Group West

abstract.#text: Frock's story introduces all the players--FedEx's resourceful and resilient leaders and employees--and shows how these remarkable individuals gave Fred Smith's original concept wings and, through flexibility, creativity, and commitment, made a fledgling startup into one of the great success stories in modern business.

physicalLocation.#text: Baker Library, Harvard Business School, Harvard University
